name: Cold Storage Capacity Above 80%

description: Asset maintenance is upcoming or overdue.

name: Asset Calibration Reminder
description: Asset calibration is upcoming or overdue.

name: Asset Status Changed
description: An asset's status has changed (e.g. functioning, malfunctioning, defrosting).

name: Unlinked RTMD
description: There are RTMDs associated with an entity that are not yet linked to an asset.

description: An asset has been in defrosting status for longer than expected.

description: Asset temperature has dropped below the minimum threshold.

description: Asset temperature has risen above the maximum threshold.

name: Material Out of Stock
description: A material's stock has reached zero.

name: Material Less than Minimum Stock
description: A material's stock has fallen below the configured minimum.

name: Stock Restored to Normal
description: A material's stock has returned to normal level from below minimum.

name: Inactive Entity
description: An entity has been inactive for a configured number of days.

name: Order Shipped
description: An order has been shipped by the vendor to the customer.

description: A relocation order has been created between entities.
